topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Finding a time capsule I don’t recall burying was a lovely surprise. The sun was just beginning to set, casting a warm glow over the garden. As I brushed the last of the dirt away, a sense of mystery took hold. I imagined the hands that placed each item inside, the thoughts and dreams of the person, or people, who intended for this to be discovered. I carefully unsealed the container, revealing photos, letters, and small mementos that felt like pieces of another life, another time, inviting me to connect with a past I suddenly felt a part of. The discovery has opened a door to reflection and wonder, a gift from the past that binds us together in shared humanity.
